title: Packaged ROM resolver matches the Workshop resolver

verification.actor: World or resolver state identified by the scenario fixture; no named actor identity credit.
verification.trigger: Load the packaged resolver service and resolve the seven named golden requests through ARM and the Workshop adapter
verification.observable: The packaged ROM and Workshop use the same behavior blob; Status, profile bytes, primitives, fingerprint, metadata, and ordered provenance are identical for every request

setupMutations.change: Import a disposable copy of test.sav and use normal boot input. Capture the real resolver service and behavior-blob pointers on a natural resolver call.

Use the shared field-return bridge and one owned 8,000-byte heap11 block for seven fixed public requests, result buffers and bounded provenance. Check live service/blob identity, native entry/return arguments, guards, unchanged inputs and heap ownership, then free the block. Do not write native registers or stack frames. Source save and behavior blob are unchanged.

limits: This proves deployment parity for seven public service calls, not natural actor movement, role projection, or unchanged authored-profile timing.
Both builds use the same resolver C implementation. Independent authored golden cases remain the separate S1 requirement; this case is not an independent behavior oracle.
Observed frames count only real emulator cycles containing the captured service work, not boot padding. All seven calls can finish in one cycle; no gameplay soak credit is claimed.
